entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin of uncommon intellect, talent and ambition, and a planeswalker who returned to Fiora to reshape Paliano's power structures.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane where Daretti returned to scheme.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city on Fiora whose power structures denied Daretti his aspirations.

entities.name: The Academy
entities.description: An institution in Paliano that Daretti's schemings caused to be disbanded; some former members are lying low.

entities.name: The goblin riots
entities.description: Riots in Paliano that Daretti helped instigate to overturn the current leadership and root out former Academy members.

events.summary: After some time away, Daretti returns to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano.
events.quote: After some time away, Daretti returned to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano that denied him his aspirations.

events.summary: Daretti's schemings cause the disbanding of the Academy.
events.quote: His schemings were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

events.summary: Daretti helps instigate the goblin riots to overturn Paliano's leadership and root out former Academy members.
events.quote: were instrumental in instigating the goblin riots
